items.title: Co-creator of Empire Market dark web marketplace given 40-year sentence
items.summary: Raheim Hamilton, 30, pleaded guilty earlier this year to a drug conspiracy charge and agreed to forfeit more than $100 million worth of Bitcoin and several properties in Virginia.
